plans.idea: Three-column banner faithful to the original: square hero bottle on the left, headline and subhead stacked as one tight block with the badge pair directly under it, the CTA vertically centred on the right, and legal running along the bottom of the text column. This removes the engine's loose vertical gaps.

Mirrored, left-to-right reading layout: headline and subhead lead on the left across a wide column, the CTA and the badge row sit side by side directly under the copy as one action group, legal sits at the foot, and the large bottle hero anchors the right edge.

Editorial stack beside the hero: the badges act as an eyebrow row above a wide, large headline and subhead, the CTA follows directly under the copy on the same left edge, and the legal text tucks into the bottom-right beside the button, so the whole right side reads top to bottom on one shared alignment line.
